raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-412 change added a filter that drops rows where ingest_ts minus txn_ts exceeds 26 hours. Since batch 3 the source delivers a sizeable share of POSTED transactions with about a 3-day lag (for example, txn_ts 2026-01-13 ingested 2026-01-16), so roughly 25% of each batch's valid transactions are silently dropped from silver and under-counted in every gold table. The txn_ids are all distinct, so these late rows are not duplicates and should be counted on their own txn_date; the fix removes the filter and keeps only the POSTED filter. Data-eng should confirm with the DE-412 owner that the lag filter was not an intended business rule.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
